narrative.overview: This is the approved personal-library prototype implemented in the unified application, not the earlier migration freeze. Cold-white working planes, near-black text and a lake-blue accent continue through the account entry, personal library and independent team library. The original connecting mark is a local brand asset, not a competitor image.
keyCharacteristics: Independent personal and team library semantics
Light navigation and a shared connecting mark
dos: Do preserve the real/demo boundary, fresh CSRF and identity checks.
Do distinguish empty, unavailable, signed-out, expired and lost-access states.
Do keep real team libraries separate from personal sharing.
donts: Don't imply real-time brush collaboration, saving, review progress or viewer loading merely from a rendered button.
Don't replace clinical or protocol verification with UI screenshots.
